title: Remove named domain-plugin assumptions from user and Agent guidance
summary: Make README, lifecycle Skill, and operator preparation use generic plugin identifiers and installed-scope selection rather than a retired named domain plugin. Implementation evidence: this change landed in b5921f9, the commit that added this record, and remains in force at 66e7e45; b5921f9 was pushed without a recorded Verification run, so the record is carried as implemented rather than verified.

platform: generic plugin lifecycle routing and scope matching
plugin: its own declaration identity and business meaning
agent: clarification when plugin selection is ambiguous

forbiddenResponsibilities: guidance hardcoded to a retired domain plugin
plugin-specific business rules in product documentation
